label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is attacker-controlled: The user-provided parameter 'param' flows through getTheParameter(), is assigned to 'bar', then used in new String(input) where input is derived from bar.getBytes(), and finally encoded with encodeForHTML before being concatenated into the HTML response. Even though encoding is applied, the data originates from user input and reaches the HTML sink, making it a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

evidence.note: param is assigned from getTheParameter() which retrieves user input
bar is assigned to param when condition (500/42) + num > 200 evaluates to true
User input reaches HTML response via encodeForHTML(new String(input)) concatenation
